verdict.rationale: Docs show the API/SDKs cover the core building blocks (enrichments, scrapes, quick_search, search_agent, dry_run, webhooks, run listing) that mirror the marketing site's feature set, suggesting broad API/UI parity. However there's no explicit confirmation that UI-only features like scheduling/monitoring for changes are exposed as API endpoints, and no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec was found (404s), leaving some parity unverified. missing for 10: explicit API endpoint for scheduling/monitoring, published OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage, independent verification of UI-API feature parity.
